title: Bonus $20 Costco Shop Card for New Gold Star Membership ($65/Year) or New Executive Membership ($130/Year) @ Costco
body:
Deal: Bonus $20 Costco Shop Card for New Gold Star Membership ($65/Year) or New Executive Membership ($130/Year) @ Costco

[TheDukeOfNukem] Don't forget to get an additional $10 gift card for turning on auto renew (in store only), and then also, don't forget to turn that off and cancel your membership 364 days into the year to come out overall $30 ahead.
[godofpizza] so can you sign up online and then turn on auto renewal (in store ) for the extra $10?
[overlook] just remember that you cannot join again for 18months so maybe at the end of it. Stock up like x amount of costco gift cards?
[Oxygenzero] Ihave signed up previous deal, but I never received the $20. Do I need to follow up at their membership desk? TIA
[overlook] dont think it always happen tho…it is not like all year around deal.
[A2E2] I have a Costco Gold Star membership gift card. Is there any way to use that towards this deal online? Looks like it can only be used at the membership counter.
[realaccount627465746] how much is the gift card for to even make this worth doing? most people spend hundreds there after joining
[A2E2] It is just a membership gift card, not a normal Costco gift card. It says "This is a Gift of Membership worth $60 toward a Costco membership or membership renewal"
[realaccount627465746] yeah seems like you can only use it at the counter
The recipient must take the membership certificate to the membership counter at any Australian Costco location to activate their Gold Star membership
https://www.costco.com.au/content/give-the-gift-of-membershi…
[generalpayne] Does anyone know if I need to wait to receive the card before I can go to the store? I have a birthday party I want to shop for over the next day or so, but won't bother signing up if I need the card as it won't come on time. I know the terms say ' 2). You will receive an email from Costco that will include your membership number.' Is this enough to get entry?
[pyramid] You can download Costco app and login using your emails, membership etc…..youndont need physical card now a days to enter in store
[generalpayne] Thanks heaps for confirming that pyramid :)
[Ni l s] Anyone know if you are classified as a new member if you (within the last year) had a partner card?
[Splagito] Keen to know. My membership ended in april
[ARD] Would be new to costco family of 3
Is it worth of 45 AUD a year from your experience
Happy to hear from you.
[AFAR85] It's worth it for the fuel savings alone if it's close by.
[Erkel] Yes their fuel and booze are usually the cheapest around.
The seafood and meat are very well priced too, but you'll be buying them in kilos at a time.
Cheapest for international foods that are usually very expensive/not found in Colesworth.
Their butter croissants are like crack. You can't stop at just one.
[eecan] I find that the quality of meat and produce is far better than Colesworth too. There are a lot of things at Costco that are just held to higher standards.
[cchhiillyy] They now have regular sales that go on that drop prices from decent to the cheapest around on a range of items. Also their cakes are like half price if you need one that large which makes it instantly paid off.
[Powershopz] I've had a membership twice now (only for 1 year) and found that it basically pays for itself off only one shop.
If you're planning on throwing at least one party/gathering a year - it's handy to stock up on basics like soft drinks and alcohol and it will have paid for itself in that one trip.
[georgev] Does Costco still refund membership fees after 6–7 months of use?
